comment: CM-TRS Job Tracking daily card — reference wiring. Compare this against your flow via Peek code. Connection ids under $connections and the two adaptive card bodies are placeholders; everything else (expressions, action names, runAfter chain) is the part that matters.

Recurrence.description: Time zone must be set on the trigger, not left at UTC, or the date printed on the card slips by a day for evening runs.

variables.name: DashboardUrl
variables.value: <<< same dashboard link the current card button already uses >>>

List_rows_present_in_a_table.description: No $filter / Filter Query on purpose: Status and Create Time are free text in CM-TRS, so OData filtering here silently returns zero rows. Pagination is on because the default cap is 256 rows.

Filter_open_jobs.description: Mirrors the dashboard rule isDone(s) = s contains 'done' or 'closed'. Uses contains, not equals, because real values include 'Done(Not Leave)'. coalesce guards null Status, which would otherwise fail the whole action and starve the condition.

Filter_open_with_time.description: WDL if() evaluates every argument, so rows with a blank Create Time must be removed before parseDateTime runs in Filter_over_sla.

inputs.where: @less(formatDateTime(addHours(parseDateTime(item()?['Create Time'], 'en-US', 'dd-MMM-yy HH:mm'), if(equals(item()?['Priority'], 'Critical'), 3, if(equals(item()?['Priority'], 'Major'), 10, 72))), 'yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss'), formatDateTime(convertTimeZone(utcNow(), 'UTC', 'SE Asia Standard Time'), 'yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss'))

Filter_over_sla.description: SLA hours match the dashboard: Critical 3, Major 10, Minor 72. Both sides are formatted to the same string shape before comparison.

inputs.select: @concat('- **', coalesce(item()?['Job ID'], '-'), '** · ', coalesce(item()?['Priority'], '-'), ' · ', coalesce(item()?['Province Name'], '-'), ' · ', coalesce(item()?['Status'], '-'), ' · ', coalesce(item()?['Assign to'], 'ยังไม่ระบุผู้รับผิดชอบ'))

Select_job_lines.description: Adaptive Card cannot loop, so the job list is flattened to markdown bullets here and joined in the card. union() concatenates the three priority buckets in order, giving a severity-sorted top 10.

Has_Open_Jobs.description: Advanced mode only. A basic condition card stores the right-hand value as a string, so length() (an integer) compared against "0" evaluates false forever. Must be body(), not outputs() — outputs() is the wrapper object and length() cannot read it.
